photos.c: Above: Maximum points in the 5000 metres.  At the halfway point Mark Miles was closely shadowed by John Nysaginia (Birchfield) and our own Stephen Sharp but by the end of the race the gap was 11 seconds with Stephen heading the B race by 20 seconds.
